      "observations": [
        "Full10-file owned Rust/C++ bridge diff read. It introduces separate auth and transport-security options with ReAuth/Alert defaults. check_auth selects silent authentication only; message send selects silent certificate handling and ordinary operations use defaults. Silent auth does not imply silent certificates. Copy/move/create callers preserve operation completion/error handling while passing the new options.",
        "On a request failure, the historical client preserves3229 credential refresh before retry/abort. A configured transport-security failure routes owning security info to AlertCertError then returns the original error; known HTTP connection errors optionally register an alert then return the error. Helper failure via ? can instead propagate its own nsresult. Alerts are side effects, not successful network completion or guaranteed visible UI.",
        "HTTP security-info extraction now treats getter_addrefs Err(NS_OK) as a null output rather than an operation success/error to return as NS_OK. With no security info it returns the original request failure; other getter failures propagate, and an NSS-classified code produces the security-info error. This avoids misclassifying an unavailable server as a certificate failure. Upstream getter/NSS implementation and runtime are bounded, not independently paired proof.",
        "Connection glue maps host/proxy-host, refused/proxy-refused, timeout/reset/interrupt codes and bails early for others. Rust FFI checks null but callers must also supply live valid objects; retained RefPtr values cover the helper call. Text conversion moves into shared alert registration. The C header removes the obsolete auth URI argument and declares the two new routes. No compiler or ABI test ran.",
        "Accepted shared machinery later uses explicit ErrorBehavior and server keys, while certificate handling uses endpoint_uri plus key. AlertUser notifies feedback listeners and may suppress its fallback; AlertCertError broadcasts to listeners. Those later contracts are not attributed to this initial URI-based registration. Send explicitly suppresses duplicate certificate handling because its outgoing listener owns that route.",
        "No tests/assertions change in this patch;3246–48 separately extend browser scenarios. Reuse exact3229 auth and3226 completion findings rather than claim all errors or all descendant/body work complete. Rust early error dispatch, owned/ref-counted values, option names and null/lifetime comments are scoped implementation facts. No network, certificate UI, prompt, build, lint, tests or runtime ran.",
